text: When the reader writes a reading, have it check whether the outcome needs a change to a governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows/*). If it does, list that file as a deliverable and name it in an acceptance criterion. Also have the producer stop and report, rather than edit, when it finds it needs a governance file the reading does not list. Add a test that a reading for a workflow change lists the workflow file.
